theorems

(* SHA256_Compress.sha256_rounds_correct *)
lemma sha256_rounds_correct:
  forall (h0 m : JWord.W32.t List.list),
    hoare[ HashExtracted.M.__sha256_rounds :
            SHA256_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ SHA256_Compress.mwords w = m ==>
            SHA256_Compress.hwords res = FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0 m ].

(* SHA256_Compress.sha256_compress_correct *)
lemma sha256_compress_correct:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (blk : BArray64.t),
    hoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_compress :
            SHA256_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ block = blk ==>
            SHA256_Compress.hwords res.`1 =
            FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0
              (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.be32
                 (BitEncoding.BitChunking.chunk 4 (BArray64.to_list blk)))
            ].

(* SHA256_Compress.sha256_compress_total *)
lemma sha256_compress_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W32.t List.list) (blk : BArray64.t),
    phoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha256_compress :
             SHA256_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ block = blk ==>
             SHA256_Compress.hwords res.`1 =
             FIPS180_SHA2.SHA256.compress h0
               (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.be32
                  (BitEncoding.BitChunking.chunk 4 (BArray64.to_list blk)))] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).

(* SHA512_Compress.sha512_rounds_correct *)
lemma sha512_rounds_correct:
  forall (h0 m : JWord.W64.t List.list),
    hoare[ HashExtracted.M.__sha512_rounds :
            SHA512_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ SHA512_Compress.mwords w = m ==>
            SHA512_Compress.hwords res = FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.compress h0 m ].

(* SHA512_Compress.sha512_compress_correct *)
lemma sha512_compress_correct:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list) (blk : BArray128.t),
    hoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha512_compress :
            SHA512_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ block = blk ==>
            SHA512_Compress.hwords res.`1 =
            FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.compress h0
              (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.be64
                 (BitEncoding.BitChunking.chunk 8 (BArray128.to_list blk)))
            ].

(* SHA512_Compress.sha512_compress_total *)
lemma sha512_compress_total:
  forall (h0 : JWord.W64.t List.list) (blk : BArray128.t),
    phoare[ HashExtracted.M._sha512_compress :
             SHA512_Compress.hwords h = h0 /\ block = blk ==>
             SHA512_Compress.hwords res.`1 =
             FIPS180_SHA2.SHA512.compress h0
               (List.map FIPS180_SHA2.be64
                  (BitEncoding.BitChunking.chunk 8 (BArray128.to_list blk)))] = (
    Real.(%r) 1).
